requirements.verbatim: Bring $250,000 or more in new deposits to qualifying linked accounts by Day 45
Maintain at least a $250,000 balance through Day 90 after account upgrade or opening
Open Premier Checking account at a branch with minimum opening deposit of $25

fee_waiver: Waived each fee period with $250,000+ in statement-ending qualifying linked bank deposit + investment account balances; also waived for each fee period ending within first 64 days of opening

churn.limit_language_verbatim: Not eligible if you received a bonus for opening a Wells Fargo Premier Checking account within the past 12 months
